# Calendar: `jl-calendar`

A month grid to pick a day, in any locale, from the pointer or the keyboard.

- Class `JlCalendar`, a molecule: `import { JlCalendar } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/calendar

A month to pick a day from. Today is marked, days of the next and previous months are muted, and days
outside min and max cannot be chosen. The header's arrows turn the page; they stop where nothing could be chosen.

From the keyboard it is a grid: the arrows move by day and week, Page Up and Page Down by month (Shift for a year),
Home and End go to the ends of the week, Enter or Space chooses. Month and weekday names come from Intl in the
locale (the page's language by default); first-day sets the day weeks start on. Dates are ISO texts
(2026-10-25) worked on as plain years, months and days, so no time zone can shift them.

## Use

```ts
import { JlCalendar } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlCalendar value="2026-11-16" />
```

```html
<jl-calendar value="2026-11-16"></jl-calendar>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `value` (attribute `value`): `string`, default `''`. The chosen day, as ISO (yyyy-mm-dd).
- `min` (attribute `min`): `string`, default `''`. The first day that can be chosen, as ISO.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `string`, default `''`. The last day that can be chosen, as ISO.
- `firstDay` (attribute `first-day`): `0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6`, default `1`. The day weeks start on: 0 for Sunday, 1 for Monday, up to 6 for Saturday.
- `locale` (attribute `locale`): `string`, default `''`. The language of the names, such as fr-CH; the page's language when empty.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The days: 32, 36 or 42 pixels.
- `name` (attribute `name`): `string`, default `''`. The field's name in the form's data.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The calendar's name for screen readers; the month's title names it otherwise.
- `required` (attribute `required`): `boolean`, default `false`. The form cannot be submitted without a day.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows the month, but nothing can be chosen.
- `invalid` (attribute `invalid`): `boolean`, default `false`. The frame in the danger colour, for an error the page found.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `change` (`onChange` in JSX), detail `string`: The chosen day changed.
- `pick` (`onPick` in JSX), detail `string`: A day was chosen, even the one already chosen.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the day the arrows move from: the chosen one, else today, else the first of the month.
- `showMonth(iso: string): void`: Shows the month of a date, without choosing it.
- `checkValidity(): boolean`: Whether a required calendar has a day.
- `reportValidity(): boolean`: The same check; when it fails, the browser shows its message on the control.

## Styling

- `--cell` (custom property): The size of a day, set by size; any length works.
- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The frame around the header and the grid.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Locales

Names and the first day of the week follow the locale and first-day.

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: start">
  <jl-calendar locale="en-US" first-day="0" value="2026-11-16"></jl-calendar>
  <jl-calendar locale="fr-CH" value="2026-11-16"></jl-calendar>
  <jl-calendar locale="de-CH" value="2026-11-16" size="sm"></jl-calendar>
</div>
```

### Within bounds

Bookings open for the next 30 days: other days are struck out and cannot be chosen.

```html
<jl-calendar min="2026-11-09" max="2026-12-09" value="2026-11-16" label="Delivery day"></jl-calendar>
```

### Listening

The sentence listens to change.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-calendar class="demo-day" label="Meeting day"></jl-calendar>
  <p class="muted demo-day-out">Pick a day.</p>
</div>
```

```js
const calendar = root.querySelector('.demo-day');
const out = root.querySelector('.demo-day-out');
calendar.events.register('change', (iso) => {
  out.textContent = `Meeting on ${iso}.`;
});
```

### Large, and disabled

```html
<div class="row" style="align-items: start">
  <jl-calendar size="lg" value="2026-11-16"></jl-calendar>
  <jl-calendar disabled value="2026-11-16"></jl-calendar>
</div>
```
